nodes.label: Input: m (integer), n (integer), coordinates (list of lists)
nodes.action: ctx['m'] = ctx['arg0']; ctx['n'] = ctx['arg1']; ctx['coordinates'] = ctx['arg2']; ctx['dict1'] = {}; ctx['dict2'] = {}

nodes.label: For each (i, j) in coordinates
nodes.action: for coord in ctx['coordinates']: ctx['i'], ctx['j'] = coord[0], coord[1]

nodes.label: Is 0 <= x < m - 1 and 0 <= y < n - 1?
nodes.logic: ctx['x'] >= 0 and ctx['x'] < ctx['m'] - 1 and ctx['y'] >= 0 and ctx['y'] < ctx['n'] - 1

nodes.label: Initialize dict2 as Counter(dict1.values())
nodes.action: from collections import Counter; ctx['dict2'] = Counter(ctx['dict1'].values())

nodes.label: Output: [total_blocks - filled_blocks, dict2[1], dict2[2], dict2[3], dict2[4]]

verification.note: ILR 描述的算法正确（x/y 从 i-1..i、j-1..j 即 x_end 为开区间端点），忠实转写可通过全部示例；生成代码却写成 range(x_start, x_end+1)，多遍历了 x=i+1、y=j+1，把不含黑格的块也计数，属代码未忠实实现 ILR。
